Extend P0613-Q01 to distinguish actuator choice from transmission rather than add a recall duplicate.

P0613-Q05 tests remote motor/lower wrist inertia but not the source-scoped pairing of direct drive with accuracy and belt drive with low moving inertia/high speed. Extend that currently flagged item into a parallel trade-off comparison; do not turn the slide into a universal accuracy guarantee.

No question requires distinguishing the configuration dependence of M11/M12 from constant M22 or the half-factor in the link-2 coupling. Extend one current item to compare configurations or explicitly identify those terms, not merely add another numerical variant.

The mass/geometry coefficient l1*l2*(m2/2+m3+m4)*sin(θ2) is never selected, derived or evaluated: Q01 supplies an undefined h and Q02 assumes it nonzero. Extend Q01 to identify or calculate this coefficient and its sign/zero condition; this can simultaneously repair the hidden definition.

The cruise position uses θa+vp*(t-ta), while deceleration uses θf-α*(tf-t)^2/2. Current items assess phase order, initial rest, travel/time feasibility and switch continuity, but not these distinct time origins or terminal-sign expression. Extend Q06 or another existing item to select/evaluate the correct position expression in cruise and deceleration under consistent hypothetical parameters.

advisories: Most citations use a slide-level locator and whole-page OCR. Precise equation/table-cell locators would improve evidence navigation; actual readable source pixels, not OCR, were used in this review.

No new numeric variant is requested solely to raise counts. Coverage targets preferentially extend existing items.
